name: Thunder
description: Powerful electric energy arcs out from you, hitting any creature in a {shape}, centered on you. Creatures caught in the area must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more become paralyzed. Creatures in range that are in flight or in the invulnerable stage of Fly or Bounce take double damage from this move.
